basics.name: Matteo Manzoni
basics.label: PhD Student in Computer Science
basics.summary: An Italian PhD Student in Computer Science at the University of Milan studying video game accessibility.

work.name: University of Milan, Milan, Italy
work.position: Research Assistant on the PRACTICE Project
work.summary: Working as a research assistant on the PRACTICE project, at the EveryWare Lab of the University of Milan. PRACTICE is a research project to enable the remote diagnosis of joint bleedings for hemophilic patients.
highlights: Development and maintenance of the backend services used for the whole project.
Maintenance of the client application used by patients.

work.name: University of Milan, Milan, Italy
work.summary: Assisted the professor during in-class sessions of the Mobile Computing course (B.Sc. in Computer Science).

work.name: University of Milan, Milan, Italy
work.position: Laboratory Instructor, Distributed and Pervasive Systems
work.summary: Teaching the laboratory module of the Distributed and Pervasive Systems course (M.Sc. in Computer Science), including designing the course projects and assessing students.

work.name: Smith-Kettlewell Eye Research Institute, San Francisco, CA, USA
work.summary: Worked as an intern at the Smith-Kettlewell Eye Research Institute under the supervision of Dr. James Coughlan. The internship was focused on the MapIO project, which aims to create an accessible interface for tactile maps using computer vision and larlge language models (LLMs).
